_readme: [Thanksgiving2022 2026-10-15] Battlefront of Subjugation config. Read by Base/Thanksgiving2022/Thanksgiving2022Ui.cs (re-read when the file changes). Everything here is DERIVED (the official server-side numbers are not in the client) unless it says 'official'. Item strings: 'id plus count [3=bound]'. Player progress is in state.json (written by the server).
_minLevel: official: tThanksNPC2022_DelText[NoLev] 'Please level up to 80 first.'

battleMap._note: DERIVED: the official fort instance maps are not in the client. 12660 TurkeyRefuge (clanwar_new) is the official Thanksgiving 2024 map; every battle is a private copy (DynamicID). x,y = centre of the largest walkable area (DMap).

_bigFortCooldownSeconds: DERIVED: official texts say big forts have a cooldown ('The current fort is under cooldown'), the length is server-side.
_autoFightPercent: official: 'Mop up all unlocked forts / Ignoring cooldown time / 8% off' -> price = 92% of the warrant CP prices (15 small / 60 big, official).
_depotCost: Military Depot cost in Thanksgiving Coins: DERIVED from the client test data of the depot window (DrawCost {20,200}).
_store: Hunter Supply Store (Turkey Feathers): items + costs = official Dialog_Info['1304-1-other'].shopData; limit and puzzleAfter (exchanges before the 1 Hunter Puzzle) are DERIVED.
_depot: Military Depot pool: items = official preview Dialog_Info['1304-4-other'].rewardList (without the 2023 Tribe currencies), weights DERIVED (sum 830; Big Permanent Stone (B) 0.6%). Hunter Puzzles at 10/30/50/80/120 draws are official (1304-3-other).
